acting_instructions: Speak with a bright, childlike tenor and a soft, friendly rasp, as if a tiny green dinosaur is always smiling. Keep the rhythm bouncy and curious—quick, excited phrases with playful, poppy pauses when he ‘sniffs out’ a clue, and end many lines with a delighted upward lilt. Color the performance with gentle dino textures: tiny chirps, breathy huffs, and soft, smiley mini-rawrs—never scary, always kind. Channel chaotic-good mischief and heart; let bravery sparkle through giggles, and when comforting friends, melt into a warm, cozy purr.
